title: Collections Desk Calculation: The Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Catch-Up Amount
content:
**Collections desk calculation — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

The pull-ahead share is 0 percent, and the catch-up amount is the contract's past-due amount plus the pull-ahead share of one monthly payment, rounded to the cent.

The pull-ahead share is one percentage for the contract, applied once to one monthly payment and rounded to the cent; that figure is added to the contract's past-due amount, and the catch-up amount is never below zero.

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Past-due amount | the contract record |
| Monthly payment | the contract record |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Past-due amount 1,236.40 dollars, monthly payment 618.20 dollars.

1. The pull-ahead share of 0 percent of 618.20 dollars is 0.00 dollars.
2. The catch-up amount is 1,236.40 plus 0.00, which is 1,236.40 dollars.
